headline: The Mediterranean, Curated
primaryText: With exceptional yachts and personalised itineraries, HELM transforms travel into something truly unforgettable.
whyItWorks: A striking aerial shot of a white yacht beside dramatic sea cliffs sells the dream before any copy is read. The overlaid line about where to go next works as a soft prompt that invites the viewer to picture their own trip. The ad has run for about two months, and its premium tone and single low-pressure click through to a destination page suit a high-consideration purchase.
